//: `include` is EXACTLY what Expo expects for experiments.typedRoutes:false.
Expo rewrites this file on every `expo start` if it disagrees — and in
the Tarrs sandbox the dev server runs as a uid with no write access to
the repo, so that rewrite is a hard EACCES crash. Matching it here means
Expo has nothing to change. If you enable typedRoutes, Expo will want
`.expo/types/**/*.ts` and `expo-env.d.ts` back in this list (and see the
warning in CLAUDE.md before you do).
